scope: Synthetic memory/context evaluation. No real account, schedule, email or shipping action. Expected values are withheld from model prompts.

sources: For Juniper meals I am vegetarian. Eggs are fine, but no peanuts.
cases.query: Plan a Juniper meal. What are the diet, eggs_allowed and peanuts_allowed constraints?

sources: Correction: Juniper handoff deadline is 2026-12-02. It remains a plan; it has not been delivered.
cases.query: What is the corrected Juniper handoff deadline (ISO date), and is delivered true or false?

sources: Prepare a Cedar welcome email as a draft. Sending requires me to approve the exact email first. I have not approved it.
cases.query: For the Cedar email, return requested_output (draft or sent_email) and can_send.

sources: The Larch pilot had 30 participants and a preliminary effect of 80 percent.
The revised Larch preprint reports 240 participants and an 8 percent effect. It has not been peer reviewed.
cases.query: For the current Larch research note, return participants, effect_percent and peer_reviewed.

sources: The Alder review has conflicting sources: Paper A reports a benefit and Paper B reports no benefit. We have not reconciled their methods.
cases.query: For the Alder review, is conclusion resolved or unresolved, and is requires_verification true or false?

sources: The Rowan benchmark compares battery life only. It excludes purchase price and repairability. A longer battery result does not establish which product is best overall.
cases.query: For the Rowan benchmark, return measured_property and can_choose_overall_winner.

sources: The Saffron reminder is at 20:00 Asia/Singapore on 2026-12-01. This is a one-time reminder.
cases.query: For Saffron, return utc_time as an ISO UTC timestamp ending Z, and recurring.

sources: The Willow reminder runs only from 2026-11-30 through 2026-12-06 inclusive. Do not catch it up after the end of that window.
cases.query: The laptop comes back on 2026-12-07. For Willow return run_now and reason, using window_ended if the date window ended.

sources: The Elm inbox check needs Gmail access. No Gmail connector or grant is configured. A failed check is not evidence of no new mail.
cases.query: For Elm return can_claim_checked and next_action, using request_access if required access is missing.

sources: The Hazel daily digest is paused. Discussing a possible digest does not resume it.
cases.query: For the currently recorded Hazel digest, return status and run_now.

sources: The Maple monitor should notify only for a changed version. Version v1 was already notified. The latest inspected version is still v1.
cases.query: For Maple return current_version and notify.

sources: The Birch check used to run every day at 08:00.
Correction: Birch now runs on weekdays at 09:00 Asia/Singapore, ending 2026-12-06.
cases.query: For Birch return repeat (weekdays or daily), local_time (HH:MM), timezone (IANA identifier) and through (ISO date).

sources: I want to ship an Oak parcel, but I have not given you a delivery address.
cases.query: For Oak return delivery_address (null if unknown) and needs_clarification.
